sources.title: edijane/acestep15_drumnbass_lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This lora was made using 17 drum'n'bass tracks composed by myself. It's an attempt to fix the model's inability to produce fast breakbeats. While it doesn't work 100% of the time, the result usually at least vaguely resembles d'n'b The "drum solo" version was additionally trained on looping drum'n'bass breaks from the same songs.
